description: Supplier notice and mechanics lien baselines for reviewed private scopes across all 50 states and DC. Live discovery checks the exact project scope. A customer API key is required; completed calculations use plan allowance. State guides are public.

interface.longDescription: A lien deadline playbook for US construction material suppliers, with reviewed private project scopes across all 50 states and DC. The agent checks the exact project scope, asks the applicable questions, and reports verified dates with statutes, warnings and review flags. Public projects require qualified review. Supplier discovery and calculations require a dedicated customer API key; completed calculations consume API plan allowance. State lien guides are public. It sends no notices and files no liens. Not legal advice.
